judgement.overall_note: Production correctly preserves all four at-risk carryover items and adds a new agreement about the news-feed sensor, which is grounded in the dialog. However, the new agreement undershoots the gold: it does not attribute the sensor-building commitment to the user explicitly, and it collapses the specific filtering axes (AI breakthroughs, equipment niche movements, critical security alerts, stripping commentary/repetition) into a vague 'high-signal technical and niche data' phrase. No decision entry was added for the news-feed sensor arrangement, contrary to the gold. Overall the update is directionally correct but lacks specificity on the new material.
